reason: A standalone memory backend for AI agents that stores, verifies, organizes, and recalls session-derived knowledge across agent sessions through local SQLite storage and documented REST/MCP integrations.

summaries.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供基于本地 SQLite 的长期记忆服务，可在会话结束时整理知识并在后续会话中检索和注入相关上下文。
summaries.en: A local SQLite-backed long-term memory service for AI agents that organizes knowledge from completed sessions and recalls relevant context in later sessions.

capabilities: Persists session transcripts, interest points, wiki pages, claims, and change logs in SQLite
Extracts, verifies, merges, archives, and recalls agent memories using configured LLM and embedding services
Injects recalled context at session start and accepts transcript data at session end
Provides REST and MCP-integrated search, recall, logs, graph, and statistics interfaces
Supports isolated or shared memory namespaces across multiple agents
